sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout table covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; selected arXiv:2606.22953 after official-date and local dedupe checks.
Read arXiv abstract, HTML, and PDF; extracted replay pairing, probe, strict stripping, compression stress test, limitations, and numeric evidence.
Explained PlanSignal formula, replay-pairing pseudocode, probe target, strict stripping protocol, and context-compression policies.
Highlighted step-index leakage, plan-content confounds, asymmetric strict stripping, limited model coverage, and null behavioral interventions.
Searched exact title and arXiv ID; found no substantive third-party analysis beyond paper index pages, so the article relies on official arXiv sources.
Pure Markdown article exceeds 5000 Chinese characters and uses tables, formulas, pseudocode, and Mermaid without external image URLs.
